existing_byte_options.why: Client timestamps, resource executor occupancy, build stage durations and three held-provider availability probes contain no independent actual mixed-operation DB acquisition timestamps.

These return already-acquired guards/units, not acquisition receipts or an observer callback. Wrapping the caller's entire query/transaction includes work; a separate BEGIN/ROLLBACK connection only probes availability.

prepare_snapshot_us is specifically OutputSnapshot::from_resolved_units plus precompress_chunks in build_plan.rs:297-309, in the lock-free prepare phase. between_stages_us is an aggregate gap among stage clocks, not an identified DB wait. Correction to preliminary wording: prepare_snapshot itself is not a DB lock measurement.

No existing permitted collector or proven attribution map for the exact release binary is available. Generic futex time mixes executor/CodeIndex/DB locks. Do not promise this closes the original requirement without a concrete independently verified collector and runner permissions.

recommended_design.principle: New explicitly instrumented supplemental build under a compile-time opt-in feature, while all default/scale compiled branches remain their original implementations. This enables a narrow actual-path equivalence proof instead of changing active default scale code merely for diagnostics.
recommended_design.not_automatic_equivalence: The following is a design property to prove after a real patch, not a claim that source identity or all binaries are already identical. Old C raw and receipts continue to carry C.
recommended_design.feature: Proposed cc-db runtime-lock-diagnostics, propagated by a same-purpose cc-server feature; absent from every default list and the scale workflow's exact Cargo invocation.

seams.design: Keep the existing std::sync::Mutex<Connection> field and Mutex::new expression in cfg-off blocks exactly. In cfg-on use an observed mutex with identical lock()/try_lock() result types; all existing write sites still receive std MutexGuard/PoisonError. New timing happens only around the actual acquisition, before SQL. Do not edit dozens of write call sites or replace locking policy.

Keep the entire old method body under cfg-off. A cfg-on alternate preserves original pool.read()/pool.get() expressions, failures and ordering, adding separate acquisition elapsed for the pool RwLock and checkout. Do not combine pool connection validation/creation elapsed with pure mutex wait.

seams.path: crates/cc-db/src/new opt-in diagnostics module and lib.rs
seams.design: Fixed metric categories and bounded per-handle counters only: no per-request growing list, background task or telemetry DB. Lock wrapper returns original standard guard/result unmodified. Record before trying, clock result, accumulate outside the semantic lock operation; retain poison/error observations. Atomic overflow explicitly invalidates diagnostic completeness instead of wrapping to zero.

Only cfg-on add a separately versioned lock_diagnostics object from the actual IndexDb handle. cfg-off emits the exact old JSON object. This must not acquire an additional database lock to report counters. Include db instance/incarnation scope and reset/availability semantics.
Only add explicit optional feature propagation; keep default/dependency versions and Cargo.lock unchanged. Prove no existing workspace feature unification accidentally enables diagnostics.

seams.path: new dedicated supplemental runner/build verifier or explicitly isolated profile in existing scripts
seams.design: Bind exact source, compiler/private target, binary, actual Cargo features and diagnostic schema. Do not weaken original []-features validator or rewrite old receipts. Call the original C1/4/8/16 workload with the original operations/files/intervals/deadlines/raw limits/terminal cleanup, preserving each new run's own timing and failures. Observer captures actual diagnostic snapshots and original raw together.

fields.semantics: Acquisition wall includes clock/acquire overhead; it is not a subtraction-based pure blocked-time estimate. Read connection checkout may include connection validation/create work and stays separately named. Aggregate population covers all actual calls for this DB within the workload window, including explicitly identified status/observer calls unless a separately reviewed exclusion is implemented. It is not a per-operation latency distribution.
fields.sqlite_boundary: SQLite engine/file-lock busy wait remains a distinct unobserved metric. This plan must not advertise the three metrics as exhaustive SQLite busy time. Original literal DB lock wait does not specify every lock class; the accepted scope must explicitly name the in-process DB synchronization measured. If the intended closure requires engine busy wait too, a separate bounded design is needed; BEGIN IMMEDIATE elapsed alone cannot supply it.

mandatory_preservation: Original lock ordering, poisoning, timeout/backoff, transaction lifetime, failure behavior and guard ownership
Original query/cache/index semantics, C1/4/8/16 populations and failure denominator
No extra server worker, no unbounded vector or product telemetry DB
No renaming of client call elapsed as backend service
Existing held-worker contention observations retain their actual fake-provider scope

meaningful_validation_before_new_evidenc: With explicit barriers, hold the actual observed writer mutex and prove a competing real acquisition remains incomplete until release and increments exactly its corresponding success/elapsed fields; no arbitrary performance threshold.
Poison and failure controls preserve the original LockResult/guard/error semantics and classify the attempt without turning it into success.
Exhaust the actual read pool, release a connection and verify checkout records the actual operation; closed pool/failure remains an error and observed/missing is not zero-filled.
Unavailable/reset/overflow counters are rejected for diagnostic completeness; snapshot subtraction cannot cross an unrecognized handle/epoch.

Default-feature source after cfg elimination has the original types, methods, call sites, imports, layout and status JSON; check feature graphs and actual scale Cargo command. Independently review all added code and prove disabled code is excluded, rather than trusting a runtime boolean.

Supplemental profile verifies declared diagnostic feature and all actual acquisition fields, whole raw/seals/terminal rows/source/binary like the original profile. Missing diagnostic fields fail the supplemental claim while preserving original raw and outcomes.

which_measurements_change.old_173: None of the original measured values become false. Existing narrower successes retain173 identity; they do not contain the missing wait observations.
which_measurements_change.current_C_scale: Continue its original150/1500 protocol unchanged. No automatic restart is justified solely by this proposal. If the real patch proves feature-off executed paths/configuration/dependencies unchanged, original C scale can be cited through an explicit relevant-input applicability proof; b107 still verifies C originals against C, never against a rewritten receipt.
which_measurements_change.scale_closure_fact: Scale uses p8_scale.rs:640 build→CodeIndexBackend::build_index_report runner.rs:131→real in-process MCP index→handlers/core.rs→DB; therefore unconditional DB/server wrappers or runtime if branches would touch its actual path. This motivates compile-time exclusion, not a claim that server code is outside scale.
which_measurements_change.supplemental_mixed: New exact-source explicitly feature-enabled C1/4/8/16 runs required for the new actual-workload lock observations, with their own full timing/error denominators. Do not splice instrumented waits into old default latency distributions.
which_measurements_change.soak: No original clause adds a new 4x-hour soak for this gap. If feature-off default source applicability is proven, C's real soak remains applicable to that default path. Feature-on supplemental mixed does not claim a diagnostic-enabled hour. Any actual change of default lock/control/cleanup semantics invalidates this narrow bridge and requires reevaluating affected runtime/lifecycle/recovery evidence.
which_measurements_change.worker: No new provider or paid/live run; use actual held-worker/backfill evidence and any directly affected controls, without inventing per-worker timing histograms.
which_measurements_change.not_approved: Root has not authorized implementation or any new run. No modifications, compile, native operation or CI/ref mutation was performed.

peer_design_scope.message_summary: Compile-time cfg-off original types/call paths is suitable for a scoped default-scale applicability proof, unlike unconditional wrappers/runtime if. Must disable all fields/types/imports/timing/atomics/status changes; verify Cargo feature unification and actual scale flags. Preserve lock/poison/guard lifetimes and distinguish writer mutex, pool lock, checkout and SQLite busy. Design opinion only, no implementation/equivalence/native approval.
